    The exact BGRS Figure-15 quotient #

    This file constructs the selected-corner quotient used in BGRS 4.3(c). In the primitive-projective convention the central Figure-15 chain is the reversed critical path

    last₀ ≫ middle₀ ≫ first₀ = 0.

    The three representatives come from one zero occurrence-by-occurrence representative of the critical path. The exact quotient ideal is generated by the right-inner radical parameter followed by middle₀, the reverse of the source's relation delta rho.
